generation: Generate public static final double fields for all numeric parameter rows before compiling. Adapter builds pure TerrainHeightField.Parameters from these values.
sourceOfTruth: Read-only original world tile grid. StaticWall instances except StaticTree, with no Building, form the mask. Player-built defense Wall blocks, trees, decorations, floors and structures never generate mountains. No floor, block, overlay, team, save or pathfinding writes.
algorithm: Exact Euclidean distance to nearest non-wall tile center, including a virtual open border. Distance layers feed a bounded exponential rise with broad deterministic value-noise modulation. Repeated weighted smoothing uses natural-wall neighbors only. Shared corners average adjacent natural cell heights. Isolated wall cells retain the minimum cliff height.

coordinates.triangles: 0,1,2 and 0,2,3; diagonal from southwest to northeast in native game XY
coordinates.surface: Piecewise linear within the exact two rendered triangles. Non-wall cells return zero even if incident shared raw vertices are elevated. Natural/open borders are intentional vertical cliffs rendered by the consumer; natural-to-natural edges are continuous. Raw vertexHeight is used only when drawing natural tiles.

lifecycle: Lazy rebuild when world tiles identity or dimensions change, explicit world invalidation, or tile event changes natural/non-natural membership. Ordinary building edits that do not change the mask do not rebuild terrain. Revision increments only after a new immutable generated field is installed. Consumer renderer must invalidate all terrain chunks after revision changes. Rebuild is deterministic and does not depend on simulation time or random state.

parameters.name: RISE_PER_LAYER
parameters.unit: tiles per erosion layer before soft cap

acceptance: No source mask or native map writes
Exact nearest non-wall distances agree with brute-force small maps
Deeper broad regions rise above edge and isolated tiles
Adjacent natural tiles share exact vertex heights
Triangle interpolation agrees with renderer and open cells remain zero
All-natural, all-open, one-cell, borders, holes and narrow regions remain finite and bounded
Same input produces identical output without consuming native RNG

tests.runtime: Parent integration smoke covers original-map fingerprints, collision, Build Mode and multiple maps
